import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static final long INF = 1L << 60;

    static class Matrix {
        int rows, cols;
        long[][] data;

        Matrix(int s) {
            rows = s;
            cols = s;
            data = new long[s][s];
        }

        Matrix(int h, int w) {
            rows = h;
            cols = w;
            data = new long[h][w];
        }

        long at(int r, int c) {
            return data[r][c];
        }

        void set(int r, int c, long val) {
            data[r][c] = val;
        }

        Matrix add(Matrix m) {
            assert rows == m.rows && cols == m.cols;
            Matrix res = new Matrix(rows, cols);
            for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < cols; j++) {
                    res.data[i][j] = (data[i][j] + m.data[i][j]) % MOD;
                }
            }
            return res;
        }

        Matrix subtract(Matrix m) {
            assert rows == m.rows && cols == m.cols;
            Matrix res = new Matrix(rows, cols);
            for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < cols; j++) {
                    res.data[i][j] = ((data[i][j] - m.data[i][j]) % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
                }
            }
            return res;
        }

        Matrix multiply(Matrix m) {
            assert cols == m.rows;
            Matrix res = new Matrix(rows, m.cols);
            for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m.cols; j++) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < cols; k++) {
                        res.data[i][j] = (res.data[i][j] + data[i][k] * m.data[k][j]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
            return res;
        }

        Matrix identity() {
            Matrix I = new Matrix(rows, cols);
            for (int i = 0; i < Math.min(rows, cols); i++) {
                I.data[i][i] = 1;
            }
            return I;
        }
    }

    static Matrix identityMatrix(int n) {
        Matrix I = new Matrix(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            I.data[i][i] = 1;
        }
        return I;
    }

    static Matrix fastPow(Matrix base, int exp) {
        assert base.rows == base.cols;
        Matrix result = identityMatrix(base.rows);
        Matrix current = base;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = result.multiply(current);
            }
            current = current.multiply(current);
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    static Matrix[] baseMatrix = new Matrix[65];

    static Matrix computeTrans(int i, int k) {
        Matrix part1 = fastPow(baseMatrix[i + k], k - i);
        Matrix part2 = fastPow(baseMatrix[i], i);
        return part1.multiply(part2);
    }

    static long compute(long n, long k) {
        if (n == 0) return 1;
        int digits = 0;
        long t = n;
        while (t > 0) {
            ++digits;
            t /= k;
        }
        Matrix[] trans = new Matrix[digits + 5];
        Matrix[] powTrans = new Matrix[digits + 5];
        trans[0] = baseMatrix[(int) (k - 1)];
        powTrans[0] = fastPow(trans[0], (int) (k - 1));
        if (digits > 1) {
            trans[1] = computeTrans((int) (k - 1), (int) k);
            powTrans[1] = fastPow(trans[1], (int) (k - 1));
        }
        Matrix suffixProd = identityMatrix(2 * (int) k + 1);
        for (int j = 2; j <= digits; j++) {
            trans[j] = computeTrans((int) (k - j % k), (int) k);
            suffixProd = suffixProd.multiply(powTrans[j - 1]);
            trans[j] = trans[j].multiply(suffixProd);
            powTrans[j] = fastPow(trans[j], (int) (k - 1));
        }
        int posIdx = 1;
        long remainder = n % k;
        n -= remainder;
        int shift = 0;
        t = n;
        if (t > 0) {
            while (t % k == 0) {
                ++shift;
                t /= k;
            }
        }
        shift = (int) ((k - shift % k) % k);
        Matrix result = identityMatrix(2 * (int) k + 1);
        int exp1 = (int) remainder;
        int exp2 = Math.max((int) (remainder - shift), 0);
        Matrix part1 = fastPow(baseMatrix[shift], exp1);
        Matrix part2 = fastPow(baseMatrix[shift + (int) k], exp2);
        result = part1.multiply(part2);
        n /= k;
        if (n == 0) {
            return (result.at(2 * (int) k, 0) + result.at(0, 0)) % MOD;
        }
        --n;
        while (n > 0) {
            long digit = n % k;
            if (digit > 0) {
                result = result.multiply(fastPow(trans[posIdx], (int) digit));
            }
            n /= k;
            ++posIdx;
        }
        result = result.multiply(trans[1]);
        return (result.at(2 * (int) k, 0) + result.at(0, 0)) % MOD;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        long k = sc.nextLong();
        for (int i = 0; i < 2 * k + 1; i++) {
            baseMatrix[i] = new Matrix(2 * (int) k + 1);
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                baseMatrix[i].set(0, j, 1);
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < 2 * k - 1; j++) {
                baseMatrix[i].set(j + 1, j, 1);
            }
            baseMatrix[i].set(2 * (int) k, 0, 1);
            baseMatrix[i].set(2 * (int) k, 2 * (int) k, 1);
        }
        System.out.println(compute(n, k));
    }
}
